correctness.rationale: PASS: The source sharp bound equals the L^q norm of uniform GOS density, q=(1-p)^(-1). For minimal parameter δ<=1 of multiplicity d, g(1-e^-t)~b exp((1-δ)t)t^(d-1). At δ<1 the dx Jacobian gives Laplace rate β=(δ-p)/(1-p); Gamma integral with shape 1+(d-1)q yields exponent d-p and, at p→δ, d-δ and source-leading b. For δ=1,d>=2, q→∞ and Stirling gives b((d-1)/(e(1-p)))^(d-1); δ=d=1 gives L^∞ limit b. A fixed tail sandwich plus bounded compact contribution controls the replacements. Checks on the exact two-equal-γ case gave normalized ratios tending to one (δ=0.4,0.8,1). Restricted to p<δ<=1, r>=2, fixed positive parameters, positive finite baseline mean.
